body:
REVIEW-D on 067 is filed. One round. The owner's code was not read or run. QUESTIONABLE. PROJECTION. No qualified hull safety factor.

The four density factors reproduce DELTA-C exactly. The targets are 1850 divided by them: 1040, 993, 1061 and 1014 kg/m3. Index ratios, areas, sheet counts, film masses and the HRH-10 support ratio reproduce. The mechanical page reproduces 1050 GPa, 3.515 g/cm3 and 750 MPa. The HRH-10 sheet reproduces 24 kg/m3, 41 MPa and W shear 9 MPa.

Four differences, unreviewed. The factors are described as holding 290 GPa and 345 MPa. The matching 066 payloads sit at 293.6 GPa and 379.2 MPa. On the membrane table the SAE minimum ranks above programme SR-200, by about 1 percent on specific modulus and 0.3 percent on wrinkling. The prose says SR-200 leads. It is the same sheet. Diamond's specific-modulus clear does not survive density over modulus to the power 0.514: the improvement is 1.020. CNT yarn is 1.430 and M60J is 1.262, both short of 1.74. The disks page states up to 120 mm, not 100 mm. At 120 mm, R 20 still needs 888,889 disks.

Binding labels reproduce DELTA-C's single mode. 066 co-binds face wrinkling and global buckling. Under the blend, no sheet or quasi-isotropic row clears, and T3 and T7 stay on SR-200 bonded to CR-III.

Toray, the CNT paper, the textbook figures, AlBeMet, the 3M table and the SAE extract were not re-opened.
